overview_description.description: Zomma develops AI desktop agents that automate financial operations workflows across the software tools teams already use. The platform trains agents to observe how staff complete tasks and then execute those workflows on their behalf in desktop and web applications without requiring APIs or custom integrations. Zomma focuses on back-office use cases in financial services, including client onboarding, compliance reviews, reconciliation, reporting, and data entry across custodian, carrier, CRM, and planning systems. Its agents read screens, extract and populate data, handle routine steps, and pause for human approval at critical actions. Zomma provides audit logging, encryption, and isolated deployments designed for regulated environments.
